query: DELETE FROM docker_repository_blobs l USING package_repository_projections r WHERE r.id = l.package_repository_id AND r.repo_type = 'hosted' AND l.created_at < $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docker_manifest_blobs dmb JOIN docker_manifests dm ON dm.id = dmb.manifest_id WHERE dm.package_repository_id = l.package_repository_id AND dmb.blob_digest = l.blob_digest )
